platform.cpu: x86-64 modern CPU with supported ORT CPU kernels
platform.supportReason: Reuse the existing Windows Job, commit, low-memory and paging supervisor unchanged in its safety behavior.

python.versionSource: sys.version and sys.version_info, stdlib-only process; no native dependency imported

installation.reason: All benchmark dependencies are pinned below. PocketSphinx's declared sounddevice dependency serves live microphone utilities, which this file-only benchmark neither imports nor uses; installing it would add an unmeasured audio stack.
installation.validationScope: Exact metadata versions and frozen file-only benchmark runtime, not unrelated environments or optional microphone/codec features.

distributions.name: pocketsphinx
distributions.purpose: Exact existing file-based baseline engine and bundled English model
distributions.license: BSD-style code and separate bundled model notices

wheelReferences.name: onnxruntime
wheelReferences.scope: Audited official Windows CPython 3.12 wheel; other wheel hashes are not claimed by this version-only lock.

benchmarkHostGuard.reason: The original low-memory PC has already answered the memory question. Do not load the model there again even if available RAM later increases.

audio.implementation: Existing AudioPreprocessor and CPython stdlib wave/array/struct
audio.input: Frozen PCM16 mono 16 kHz WAV fixtures

g2p.dependency: Pinned CMUdict bytes and stdlib only

ctcAndGop.implementation: Existing V2 ctc_alignment.py and scorer.py unchanged

notRequired.name: sounddevice
notRequired.reason: Declared by PocketSphinx, but only live-audio helpers use it; benchmark uses Decoder with saved PCM WAV.

notRequired.name: ffmpeg/imageio-ffmpeg
notRequired.reason: No codec conversion or binary redistribution in this bundle.

notRequired.name: phonemizer/espeak
notRequired.reason: Pinned CMU dictionary and explicit phoneme mapper are reused; model name does not imply a phonemizer runtime dependency.

notRequired.name: transformers/tokenizers/torch
notRequired.reason: No remote Python code, FP32 path, tokenizer download or training dependency.

licensePolicy: Preserve upstream dependency, bundled model, dictionary and native component notices. Downloaded wheels and model artifacts remain outside Git. No assumption that the whole stack shares a single license.
